claims.claim_text: The indexed Robert C DeWeese Jr. has a high-confidence match to an official Army enlistment record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The protected service identifier agrees and the full name including Jr. matches after joining the Army record's spaced surname. The record does not name an employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: nonshared protected identifier, given name, middle initial and suffix agree; surname spacing is the only difference. Box 184 file not reviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The wartime Army entry establishes identity context but not the immediate pre-OSS affiliation or last civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: Separate from adjacent Robert K Deweese. Do not convert Army civilian-occupation code 993 to a named employer.

sources.locator_override: Bulk record ordinal 6230024; protected identifier and name comparison

claims.claim_text: The indexed Howard P Dewitt has a high-confidence match to an official Army enlistment record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The protected service identifier and full given name and middle initial agree; the Army surname DE WITT differs only in spacing. No employer is named.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: nonshared protected identifier and full name agree apart from surname spacing. Box 184 file not reviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The wartime Army entry does not establish the Army-to-OSS transfer date or a civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: Do not infer a named employer from civilian-occupation code 308 or from an unrelated Howard DeWitt namesake.

sources.locator_override: Bulk record ordinal 558804; protected identifier and name comparison

claims.claim_text: The indexed Jack W Dexter has a high-confidence match to an official Army enlistment record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The protected service identifier and indexed full name agree exactly with the Army entry. The entry supplies no named employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: nonshared protected identifier and exact full-name agreement. Box 184 file not reviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry does not establish the immediate pre-OSS assignment or final civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: Occupation code 476 is not a named employer or evidence that the occupation continued to OSS entry.

sources.locator_override: Bulk record ordinal 6294476; protected identifier and name comparison

claims.claim_text: The indexed Major Albert P Dewey resembles OSS officer A. Peter Dewey, but a service-identifier discrepancy prevents a confirmed match.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The NPS account agrees on the expanded name, major rank and OSS setting. A secondary transcription of a War Department award citation differs from the printed index by one identifier digit.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Ambiguous pending comparison of the original Box 184 personnel file, War Department order, and separately cited RG 226 Entry 92A file.
claims.temporal_assessment: The NPS candidate's Chicago Daily News chronology cannot be assigned to the indexed person while identity remains unresolved.
claims.match_notes: Full service identifiers are withheld. The discrepancy could reflect a transcription or index error, but neither explanation is presumed.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Official Army bulk record ordinal 6230024 and the NARA index agree on a nonshared protected identifier, Robert C and Jr.; DE WEESE versus DeWeese is spacing only. The adjacent Robert K remains separate.
person_updates.next_action: Review Robert C DeWeese Jr.'s Box 184 file for Army-to-OSS sequence and named last civilian employer; do not merge with Robert K Deweese.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Major Albert P Dewey's printed Box 184 row and the NPS account of Major A. Peter Dewey are suggestive, but the transcribed War Department order has a one-digit different protected service identifier. The two OSS files have not been compared.
person_updates.next_action: Compare Box 184, RG 226 Entry 92A Box 29 Folder 421, and original War Department General Orders No. 23 before assigning the NPS biography or Chicago Daily News employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index names Dorothy Dewey without a rank or identifier. An entertainer, a British later-born namesake and a modern university figure found in discovery searches have no OSS or Box 184 bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Dorothy Dewey's Box 184 file for full identity, personnel grade and pre-OSS occupation or employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The indexed Eugene E Dewey has a protected identifier, but CIA, LoC, exact-name OSS, occupational and institutional searches reviewed here yielded no independently linked person or employer.
person_updates.next_action: Review Eugene E Dewey's Box 184 file and compare its identifier against military or institutional records.

person_updates.identity_evidence: A same-name Charles Dewey Jr. is mentioned as an OSS China veteran in derivative sources and a Newberry finding-aid search lead, but no accessible source checked links the index's otherwise unidentified Box 184 row to that man.
person_updates.next_action: Review Charles Dewey Jr.'s Box 184 file; seek the original Newberry Goodman family papers finding aid and a dated pre-OSS work record before assigning any biography.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The indexed Major John N Dewey Jr. has a protected identifier, but exact OSS, employer, institutional and obituary checks produced no independent match with that rank and identifier.
person_updates.next_action: Review John N Dewey Jr.'s Box 184 file for rank-linked identity and dated pre-OSS employer or military unit.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index gives only P C Dewiart, without rank or identifier. Exact and spelling-variant searches did not identify a person linked to OSS Box 184; similarly spelled unrelated names are not merged.
person_updates.next_action: Review P C Dewiart's Box 184 file for expanded name, spelling and previous occupation or institution.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Official Army bulk record ordinal 558804 and the NARA index share a nonshared protected identifier and Howard P Dewitt/DE WITT differs only in surname spacing.
person_updates.next_action: Review Howard P Dewitt's Box 184 file for Army-to-OSS sequence and named last civilian employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index names Joe A Dewsbury without rank or identifier. A later Detroit tax-law namesake is not linked to the Box 184 record or dated pre-OSS occupation.
person_updates.next_action: Review Joe A Dewsbury's Box 184 file for identity, grade and pre-OSS work before considering later namesakes.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Official Army bulk record ordinal 6294476 and the NARA index share a nonshared protected identifier and exact Jack W Dexter name.
person_updates.next_action: Review Jack W Dexter's Box 184 file for Army-to-OSS sequence and named last civilian employer.
